nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $x$ be a positive integer, and let $\Phi_p$ be the $p$-th cyclotomic polynomial with integer coefficients. Then $p \mid x^p - 1$ if and only if $p \mid x - 1$ and $p \mid \Phi_p(x)$.

nodes.summary: Let $p$ be a prime, let $r$ and $a$ be natural numbers with $r$ coprime to $p$, let $x$ be a positive integer, and let $\Phi_p$ be the $p$-th cyclotomic polynomial with integer coefficients. Then $p \mid x^{rp^a} - 1$ if and only if $p \mid x^r - 1$ and $p \mid \Phi_p(x^{rp^{i-1}})$ for every $i \in \{1, \dots, a\}$.
